title: Fourier coefficient of a finite sum
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $π$, and let $ι$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $B$ is a basis of real-valued functions on $Ω$ that is orthonormal for the $π$-weighted inner product and has a distinguished index $0_B$ whose basis function is constantly one. For every $n\ge 0$, finite set $s$, family of functions $f_k:Ω^n\to\mathbb R$ indexed by a type $κ$, and multi-index $a\inι^n$, the Fourier coefficient of the sum of $f_k$ over $k\in s$ equals the sum of their Fourier coefficients at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty basis index set $ι$ with decidable equality
Orthonormal basis of functions $Ω\to\mathbb R$ under $π$, with a distinguished constant-one basis vector
Finite set $s$ in an arbitrary index type $κ$
